title: CEL-Seq
scope: Original CEL-Seq implementation, at the explanatory scope of the assigned Illumina CEL-Seq schematic and its two poster repetitions. Three representative cells remain separately routed through indexed reverse transcription and second-strand cDNA synthesis, then are pooled for one round of T7 in vitro transcription, converted to a DNA sequencing library, PCR amplified, sequenced and separated by cell index. The primary-supported cDNA/IVT interpretation corrects the misleading second-strand RNA caption and missing explicit IVT block. CEL-Seq2 improvements and neighboring poster methods are outside this scope.
